name: @workerv2/pdf-export
description: Worker V2 PDF Export Processor — the first concrete document exporter, built with the Processor SDK, that converts an immutable Document into a DETERMINISTIC PDF Artifact. Pure-TypeScript PDF generator (no non-deterministic PDF library: timestamps, random ids, object ordering, and producer/creation metadata are overridden/normalized) + PDF assembly/page placement + metadata writer + export configuration + PDF validation + PDF descriptor + a test harness. Consumes immutable Documents + resolves referenced Page Artifacts; modifies NO Documents, renders NO pages, processes NO images, composes NO layouts, and performs NO storage/networking (production goes through the Artifact Platform via the SDK gateway).
